name: MATH 3620
title: Foundations of Actuarial Science
description: The foundations of actuarial science, the role of the actuary, external forces that influence actuarial work, and the framework and processes used in actuarial work.
requirement_description: MATH 2620. Not open for credit to students who have passed MATH 2610 or FNCE 3221 or HCMI 3221. Repeat restrictions apply; see advising.uconn.edu/repeat-policy for details.
